name: Unknown batch executor unauthenticated execute(actions)
summary: EOA 0x98289e90 deployed an unverified batch executor and gave it an unlimited yvWETH allowance. Its execute((uint8,bytes)[]) (selector 0x49650044) runs arbitrary calls for any caller. An attacker's constructor had it transferFrom the owner's entire 384.667 yvWETH balance to itself, withdraw the underlying from the Yearn vault, and send the 429.21 WETH to the attacker.
notes: Direct, non-upgradeable runtime created through the deterministic CREATE2 deployer; execute() is open from creation (no caller check in the trace). The owner's later unlimited yvWETH approval only set exposure.

The stolen yvWETH is valued at the vault's pricePerShare before the exploit times the WETH price; the attacker's withdraw with 10000 bps maxLoss realised slightly less WETH, a strategy loss borne by the stolen shares.
